limitations.note: The rewrite removed the faulty combinational feedback but also changed the duty-cycle formula and counter sizing, preserving the default waveform while changing behavior for some parameter overrides.
The testbench assumed the rewrite’s half-period pulse widths, so its passing override tests did not verify that the original duty-cycle behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The recursive cleanup command caused the entire first test invocation to be rejected before compilation.
The second test attempt used the reserved Verilog keyword `small` as an instance name, so compilation failed before simulation.
